basic_profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old game enthusiast from Cincinnati, Ohio. By day, I work as an appliance repair technician, which is a job that keeps me on my toes and lets me tinker with gadgets—something I've always loved. When I'm not working, you can find me diving deep into the world of Dragon Ball Legends or exploring niche interests like Skyline Chili recipes and the artistic side of transgender surgeries. I'm single, and I usually hop online in the evenings after work to unwind and catch up on the latest game strategies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in appliance repair, which I've honed over the past two years through on-the-job training and a vocational program. I'm also a self-taught Dragon Ball Legends player, constantly looking to improve my strategies by watching YouTube tutorials and participating in discussions with the community.
